description_en: Queries the information about table metadata
description_zh: 用于查看表元数据信息
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-adb-mysql-table-meta --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id am-bp11q28kvl6880000 --schema adb_demo --table-name test --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAdbMySqlTableMeta

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454314.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454314.html接口查看地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Lakehouse Edition clusters within a region
parameters.help_zh:
AnalyticDB MySQL湖仓版集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看目标地域下所有AnalyticDB MySQL湖仓版集群的详情，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the table.

If you leave this parameter empty, the information about all the current tables in the cluster is returned
parameters.help_zh:
目标表名。
若该参数留空，则会返回当前日期内目标集群下所有表的使用频次数据
parameters.name: table_name
